notes: RECORD THIS ONE — script 15. A species other than dog or cat, with vocabulary Whisper handles less well: 'gut stasis', 'molar spurs', 'critical care'. expected.presenting_complaint: Anorexic since the previous evening. Reduced and undersized faecal output. Hunched posture, not emerging from the hutch as normal.
expected.examination: Hunched posture consistent with pain. Abdomen doughy on palpation with no detectable gut motility. Spurring on the lower left molars. Weight 2.1 kg.
expected.assessment: Gastrointestinal stasis, likely secondary to dental pain from molar spurs.
expected.plan: Subcutaneous fluids. Meloxicam for analgesia at 0.6 mg/kg. Syringe feeding with critical care formula every four hours including overnight, as much as tolerated. Burr molar spurs under sedation tomorrow if stable.
expected.follow_up: Re-present tomorrow for dental burring under sedation.
